# kcore_node (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kcore_node" "worker" {
  id = var.node_id
}

output "node_address" {
  value = data.kcore_node.worker.address
}

output "node_dc" {
  value = data.kcore_node.worker.dc_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Node ID

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Node gRPC address
- `cpu_cores` (Number) Total CPU cores
- `cpu_cores_used` (Number) Used CPU cores
- `dc_id` (String) Datacenter identifier
- `hostname` (String) Node hostname
- `last_heartbeat` (String) Last heartbeat timestamp
- `memory_bytes` (Number) Total memory in bytes
- `memory_bytes_used` (Number) Used memory in bytes
- `status` (String) Node status (ready, not-ready, unknown)
- `storage_backend` (String) Node storage backend (filesystem, lvm, zfs)
